territories.name: Uzbekistan
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Uzbekistan levies a value added tax of its own under its Tax Code of 30 December 2019: article 258 sets the rate at 12 per cent from 1 January 2023 and the zero rate for the supplies of chapter 36, articles 243 to 246 exempt the supplies they list, and the tax period is the calendar month (article 259).
